janet_acme: Hi — urgent customer report. After last night's release our docs generator started returning malformed markdown: missing closing code fence and stray backticks inserted mid-snippet. Customer flow is blocked (rendering fails). Example (input -> expected -> actual):

janet_acme: input to API:
```json
{
  "prompt": "Generate a usage example with a code block",
  "stop": ["\n```"],
  "model": "rwd-infer-qa-v1",
  "max_tokens": 200
}
```

janet_acme: expected snippet in response:
```
Here is the example:
```js
console.log("hi")
```
```

janet_acme: actual response from API:
```
Here is the example:
```js
console.log("hi")
```
```extra

janet_acme: Note the trailing "extra" after the code fence. Request ID: req_0a1b2c3d. Endpoint: /v1/generate. Model tag: rwd-infer-qa-v1@2026-03-15-3.9.1. Customer reported this started immediately after the 03:12 UTC rollout.

alice_cs: Thanks Janet — can you paste the raw response body (not the rendered HTML) and the exact cURL you used? Also which customer account and whether they are on Dedicated or Hosted?

janet_acme: raw body attached below (copied from logs):
```
{
  "id": "resp_abc123",
  "choices": [
    {
      "text": "Here is the example:\n```js\nconsole.log(\"hi\")\n```\n```extra",
      "finish_reason": "stop"
    }
  ]
}
```
Customer: Acme Docs (hosted). cURL we used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXX' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"rwd-infer-qa-v1","prompt":"Generate a usage example with a code block","stop":["\n```"],"max_tokens":200}'
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: release 2026-03-15-3.9.1 deployed to prod at 2026-03-15T03:12:08Z (canary->all).

bob_eng: I think I've seen a similar symptom in canary logs yesterday — looks like an edge case in the stop-seq handling interacting with our fence-detection heuristic. Can you grep the exact logs for resp_abc123 and attach the model runtime dump? Also: which tokenizer and quantization profile was used for that model variant?

janet_acme: grep output for resp_abc123:
```
[2026-03-15T03:21:10Z] resp_abc123 model=rwd-infer-qa-v1 slot=pool-8 finish_reason=stop tokens_consumed=78 raw_generated_tokens=["Here","is","the","example","\n```js","console",".","log","(\"hi\")","\n```","```extra"]
```

dmitri_ml: This smells like a tokenization normalization change in the runtime where a closing fence followed immediately by another token is being merged/escaped incorrectly. We pushed a micro-optimization to collapse adjacent fence-like tokens in 3.9.1 to reduce memory churn. If that's the culprit, we should revert that change for the QA models and produce a targeted hotfix.

carol_prod: Marking as P1 for customer impact (rendering broken on hosted). @bob_eng @dmitri_ml please coordinate a rollback/hotfix. CS: offer Acme a temporary workaround (post-process to sanitize trailing tokens) and set expectations.

bob_eng: Repro steps I used locally (confirmed):
```bash
# same request as customer
python -c "import requests, json; r=requests.post('https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/generate', json={'model':'rwd-infer-qa-v1','prompt':'Generate a usage example with a code block','stop':['\n```'],'max_tokens':200}); print(r.text)"
```
Observed same trailing garbage. Quick mitigation: set explicit stop to include both the fence and newline sequence, e.g. stop=['\n```','\n```extra'] — ugly but stops the immediate customer break while we fix root cause.

alice_cs: I'll pass the mitigation to the customer and offer a small credit. Can we get an ETA for a proper fix/rollback?

bob_eng: We can revert the micro-optimization on runtime line that normalizes fence tokens and push a hotfix to canary -> prod within ~4 hours if no regressions. If that is risky, we can patch the tokenizer to treat triple-backtick sequences as atomic tokens (safer). I'll target 4h for hotfix, 12-24h for full rollback if needed.

dmitri_ml: Agree with tokenizer atomic approach; less likely to regress other outputs. I'll prepare a unit test with multiple fence permutations.

carol_prod: Great — CS to keep customer updated. I'll open an incident and tag eng-runtime, eng-ml, and support. Incident ID INC-2026-0315-42.

alice_cs: Acknowledged. Janet — can you confirm customer accepts the temporary stop-array workaround? If so I'll send instructions and an apologetic note.

janet_acme: Customer accepted temporary workaround and will apply stop=['\n```','\n```extra'] for now. Asking for ETA on permanent fix. Thanks team. :pray:

bob_eng: Noted. I'll post updates in this thread as soon as canary hotfix is up.

ops-bot: incident-bot: INC-2026-0315-42 created and linked to thread.

bob_eng: Hotfix pushed to canary at 2026-03-15T06:18:40Z, rolling to prod. Patch makes triple-backtick sequences atomic in tokenizer. Will monitor metrics and customer repros.

alice_cs: Customer confirmed resolved on their side at 2026-03-15T06:45:10Z. Closing loop after postmortem. :white_check_mark:
